rows.recipe: Hiding a stage's ramp behind its predecessor (weights in registers / L2 before `griddepcontrol.wait`, bulk L2 prefetch) at attention -> O and O -> b1 -> pool_router
rows.old_result: Every recipe loses (+0.1 to +10.8 us, `5cefdbc4`, `cc718d3f`); the oracle ceilings with the bytes already warm are <= 0.7 us (attention -> O) and <= 2.0 us (pool_router)
rows.mechanism: The 2.36 us cold-read intercept (`7b6c96b5`) is mostly launch, flush and tail, not latency that a prefetch hides; prefetches compete with the running stage for HBM and issue
rows.leaves_open: Unpooler at t=16/32 only by reading its bytes during an HBM-idle predecessor (none at small M)
rows.new_verdict: No old all-load/host-equivalence reversal established by retained receipts; keep only the measured recipe conclusion. Component losses are not a family closure.

rows.recipe: Skip pool/unpool rows without local experts
rows.old_result: Local no-route medians 13.3%/14.8% at verify 16/32; range 1.6-24.6%; H200 unmeasured
rows.mechanism: Still reads weights; compaction+router dependency; estimated <=2-4 us/verify layer
rows.new_verdict: No old all-load/host-equivalence reversal established by retained receipts; keep only the measured recipe conclusion. Component losses are not a family closure.

rows.recipe: Router-epilogue L2 prefetch of the MoE's first W13 tiles (M=1, 13.9 MB)
rows.old_result: Router node 4.1 -> 51.2 us; router+MoE 53.2 -> 92.2 us (local sm_120, read flush)
rows.mechanism: One CTA's bulk prefetches run at a single SM's TMA rate and hold the CTA's exit, so the dependent MoE waits
rows.leaves_open: Weight prefetch issued from many SMs
rows.new_verdict: No old all-load/host-equivalence reversal established by retained receipts; keep only the measured recipe conclusion. Component losses are not a family closure.

rows.mechanism: Not isolated; NT1 already reads 1.4-1.7 TB/s unique and the recode alone gives 9-12%, so per-weight decode work, not bytes in flight alone, binds at small M (inference)

rows.old_result: vs S7's H_H 232.99 us (read flush, 12 seeds x 3, gates pass): best B64s2 1.1305, T32_A64 (only > 32-row experts) 1.1500, A64 1.26, P64/P128 1.39, P32 1.46; heavy W13 phase 55.6 -> 97-114 us; at M=16/32 2.2-2.8x NT1; grid 528/1056/2112, N width and ring depth barely move it

rows.recipe: MoE NT1 joint E2M1x E4M3 table decoders (sm_90a K-loop, NT=1 g-loop)

rows.mechanism: Per weight pair the table costs 2 LDS + LOP3/SHF/LEA index math + a PRMT pack, more than LOP3's bit decode; screened by static instruction count (not an H200 family closure)

rows.new_verdict: No old all-load/host-equivalence reversal established by retained receipts; keep only the measured recipe conclusion. Component losses are not a family closure.

rows.mechanism: Rebuilding PRMT selectors on V9's layout grows the sm_90a inner loop 492 -> 1,255 instructions (LOP3 162 -> 545, SHF 112 -> 368)
rows.leaves_open: A layout packed for PRMT in prepare
rows.new_verdict: No old all-load/host-equivalence reversal established by retained receipts; keep only the measured recipe conclusion. Component losses are not a family closure.
